confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregated Tokyo cost-of-living and menu sources (Numbeo-based Expatica data, Citycost, Whereandwhen, Expatistan, hotel and bar menus) and are mostly undated 2026 figures, not July-specific. Yen was converted at about 160 JPY per USD, the rate implied by those sources' own dollar equivalents. Wine glass is weak: it is inferred from hotel-bar prices, and cocktail is a bounded estimate across bar tiers. Accommodation values are holistic model estimates for July peak season, not inspected listings. FX is weak: the latest RBA figures I could confirm were for 18 to 20 March 2026, so the observation is not the latest available on 2026-11-19 and should be replaced with the current RBA value before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Tokyo-specific aggregated price sources. Accommodation anchors are a model estimate for central Tokyo in peak summer, with no accommodation search performed.
